name: high-utility-low-offense
category: pool with one high-utility low-offense mon
notes: Eleven functional attackers plus Cottonee: a status-rich, offense-poor body at cap 25 (Leech Seed / Stun Spore / Charm, feeble Absorb-tier damage). Utility roles are gated by the non-passive floor and weighted below attacker roles, so a mon that cannot threaten anything must not displace a real attacker in a PvE team.
